-- =================================================================
-- Description:	This gets a basic report for [HistoricoDocumento] table
-- =================================================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rpt_HistoricoDocumento_Index]
@EntityId AS INT = 0, 
@Documento_Id AS INT = 0, 
@Usuario_Id AS INT = 0
AS
BEGIN
	
	-- IMPORTANT:
	-- This is a computer generated procedure.  DO NOT ADD CUSTOM CODE TO THIS PROCEDURE.

	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	
	-- 1) CREATE FILTER TABLE:
	DECLARE @HistoricoDocumentoFilter TABLE (
		Id INT IDENTITY (1,1),
		HistoricoDocumento_Id INT		
	)


    -- IF A GIVEN ID HAS BEEN SPECIFIED, THEN RETRIEVE THAT RECORD ONLY
	IF @EntityId <> 0
	BEGIN

		INSERT INTO @HistoricoDocumentoFilter (HistoricoDocumento_Id)
		SELECT 
			[HistoricoDocumento].Id
		FROM [dbo].[HistoricoDocumento]
		WHERE
			 [dbo].[HistoricoDocumento].[Id] = @EntityId

	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN

		-- 2) FILTER BY FOREIGN RELATIONSHIPS WHEN APLICABLE:
		INSERT INTO @HistoricoDocumentoFilter (HistoricoDocumento_Id)
		SELECT 
			[HistoricoDocumento].Id
		FROM [dbo].[HistoricoDocumento]
		WHERE
			 (([HistoricoDocumento].[Documento_Id] = @Documento_Id) OR (@Documento_Id = 0)) AND
         (([HistoricoDocumento].[Usuario_Id] = @Usuario_Id) OR (@Usuario_Id = 0))

 	END

 
	-- 4) DELIVER THE FILTERED RESULTS:
	SELECT 
		[HistoricoDocumento].[Id],
		[HistoricoDocumento].[Documento_Id],
		[HistoricoDocumento].[Fecha],
		[HistoricoDocumento].[Usuario_Id],
		[Usuario].[Nombre] + ' ' + [Usuario].[ApellidoPaterno] + ' ' + [Usuario].[ApellidoMaterno] as NombreCompleto,
		[Usuario].[CorreoElectronico] AS [CorreoElectronico],
		[HistoricoDocumento].[Descripcion],
		[HistoricoDocumento].[EsComentario],
		[Documento].[Folio] AS [DocumentoFolio],
		[Usuario].[CorreoElectronico] AS [UsuarioCorreoElectronico],
		[Usuario].[Nombre] AS [UsuarioNombre]
	FROM @HistoricoDocumentoFilter filter
		JOIN [dbo].[HistoricoDocumento] 
			ON [HistoricoDocumento].[Id] = filter.[HistoricoDocumento_Id] 			

		LEFT JOIN [dbo].[Documento]
		ON [dbo].[HistoricoDocumento].[Documento_Id] = [dbo].[Documento].[Id] 

 		LEFT JOIN [dbo].[Usuario]
		ON [dbo].[HistoricoDocumento].[Usuario_Id] = [dbo].[Usuario].[Id] 

 
END
-- END OF [dbo].[cgp_HistoricoDocumento_Index]
Name: rpt_HistoricoDocumento_Index
